systems.platform: operated under contract by Pesaflow Limited, Webmasters Kenya and Olivetree Limited
systems.owner: Government of Kenya, full ownership since 2023
systems.tiers: online portal to apply for, pay for and track public services, birth registration listed among them; about 20,000 services

note: Birth registration is listed once among services citizens can apply for and pay for on e-Citizen; the document is about the pace of migrating services to the portal and says nothing on how the registrar makes the record.
